title: Review shared Gallery exit evidence
requires: Access to shared Gallery and platform evidence
scope: Review that one common runtime serves desktop and mobile and that the Android Gallery exposes and qualifies every Vulkan-advertised scene and action.
acceptance: No duplicate scene lifecycle, controller, catalog or frame policy remains in platform shells without a documented OS-specific reason.
Android device evidence proves native rendering, capability-accurate scene coverage, controls, lifecycle and bounded workload behavior.

history.reason: Shared Gallery ownership review passed; physical Pixel 7 evidence covers all 28 Vulkan-advertised scenes, common controls and lifecycle with bounded work, while measured performance risk remains explicit.
